title: •At Peace
caption: •At Peace (V)
game_text: Deploy on Yoda’s Hut. You may not deploy {permanent-weapon} or {maintenance} cards. May lose 2 Force to cancel an attack. May place {set:endor} Leia from hand on bottom of Reserve Deck. May use 1 Force to deploy a Jedi Test from under your Starting Effect. {alter}
lore: To recover from the strenuous Jedi training routine and revitalize the mind and body, an apprentice must rest to be calm and at peace.

notes: Unique. Banner EFFECT (no grabber box) — the printed Dagobah card is an IMMEDIATE EFFECT; the slip turns it into a plain Effect, so the remaster needs the Effect bottom half. Inline icons: black square + green blade → {permanent-weapon} (same image as {lightsaber}; the stub reads 'permanent-weapon' cards, as in vs11/24), gold spoked wheel → {maintenance}, silver-blue sphere before Leia → {set:endor} (matches set-endor-grainy; stub 'Endor-set Leia'), trailing red circle-slash A → {alter}. Curly apostrophe Yoda’s. Margin credits: left 'Original concept by Jared Arthur', right 'Arizona Mini Open 2003'. Only scan: 745 px Dagobah-L-atpeace.gif, tagged D-E1 (errata face; top half/lore same) — art only. Lore matches the scan. Copyright 1997 legible. Modern: V21-L-atpeace.gif (745 px, VS21 remake); VB6 (350) also exists.
